### Sheep, Wolves, Snakes, and Doves
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/sheep-wolves-snakes-and-doves
Passage: Matthew 10:16
Points:
- Believers are sent into a hostile world in vulnerability and weakness rather than worldly power.
- Being compared to sheep highlights natural defenselessness rather than an excuse for foolishness.
- Serpentine wisdom calls believers to step aside and avoid unnecessary trouble when possible.
- Dove-like innocence requires spotless integrity so adversaries have no moral ground for accusation.
- Discernment shaped by Scripture helps Christians know when to escape danger and when to stand firm.

### Lessons from Nature
Author: Tom Ascol
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lessons-from-nature
Passage: Matthew 10:16
Points:
- Believers are like sheep, helpless on their own and entirely dependent on the Good Shepherd.
- The world acts like a pack of wolves, operating aggressively and placing Christians at an earthly disadvantage.
- Christ sends His followers on the supernatural mission of calling wolves to become sheep.
- Serpentine prudence enables Christians to discern and avoid hazards without resorting to sin.
- Dove-like purity must govern all Christian shrewdness to maintain upright character and witness.
